Physiotherapists licensed to practice include physiotherapist supply, i.e. all Physiotherapists who were eligible to practise in the given year (including those employed and those not employed at the time of registration). Note that secondary registrants (also known as interprovincial duplicates) are excluded from the supply. In Quebec, there are 2 types of physiotherapy professionals: PTs and physical rehabilitation therapists (PRTs); only PTs  are included in the supply. For more information about data collection and comparability as well as notes specific to individual provinces and territories, refer to Physiotherapists in Canada, 2020 â€” Methodology Notes  on CIHIâ€™s website: cihi.ca/en/health-workforce
Regulatory data was not available from the Northwest Territories and Nunavut, as there were no licensing authorities in the territory.
CIHI data is as of October 1 of given year for data from the Health Workforce Database at CIHI.

This data is provisional and is subject to change. Provisional data may be incomplete and counts may not match those published by other sources due to variability in data collection and reporting.
